body.statement: Let the finite order, resolutions, weights, and nonempty open extension set be those derived in \(\mathrm{oeq:multiresolution\mbox{-}order\mbox{-}frontier}\). For every compact \(K\) in its derived validity region, there are \(C_K<\infty\) and \(n_K\) such that, for every \((\alpha,\beta,\gamma)\in K\), every \(n\geq n_K\) with \(P_n=1\), and the total estimator \(\widehat{\tau}^{P}_n(x_0)\) derived from \(\mathfrak H_P\), \[\sup_{P\in\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{band}}}\mathbb{E}_P\left|\widehat{\tau}^{P}_n(x_0)-\tau_P(x_0)\right|\leq C_K r_n^*.\] Its validity region contains \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{bank}}\) and contains the derived open set \(U\) outside it, so this is a strict region extension of the banked close-pair theorem. The bound has no logarithmic loss and uses no density estimate or density smoothness.
body.justification: This turns the rank-stressed regime from a logarithmically inflated fallback into an exact-benchmark branch.
body.gap: Shen et al. and Dobriban et al. analyze variance identities with one regression nuisance; their cancellations do not deliver the causal bilinear target or the required asymmetric H\"older product bias.
body.consumer: It covers observational studies whose optimizer demands more local nuisance resolution than the empirical window rank permits.
